ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 0.08:1; predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel regions punctuated by high-intensity (white) micro-speckling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive distribution of small, high-contrast white focal spots (1-5 pixels) across both lobes; highest density of these geometric blobs is localized on the lateral fluke tips and the lower leading-edge boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 146 degrees and a depth-to-span ratio of less than 0.05.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitudes of 2-8 pixels; irregular peaks and valleys are most pronounced on the distal 25% of the trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve with initial concavity at the median notch transition into a broad convex arc toward the lateral terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density spatial detection of circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with historical barnacle colonization across the entire ventral fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, unaligned vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the medial-right lobe surface.
